data_scope: NQ clean Databento RTH history through 2026, post-lookback-90 eligible sessions; historically consumed discovery sample
primary_metric: Zero-eligible-session daily net-ATR-R Sharpe uplift and max-drawdown improvement versus paired Null-C Sharpe uplift distribution
result_summary: REJECT: frozen gap/RVOL sizing improved real zero-day Sharpe 1.288->1.398 (+0.111), net R 91.20->101.97 (+10.78R), and maxDD 4.70->4.42R at 0.957x mean trade weight, with positive net-R deltas pre-2023 (+8.40R) and 2023+ (+2.38R). However, paired Null C reproduced mean Sharpe uplift +0.074 (sd 0.045); real-vs-null z=0.81 and 30% of draws beat real, failing z>=2. Do not adopt as validated alpha; at most retain as a default-off future-shadow sizing candidate.
